findings.claim: Criterion 1.1 requires focused tests for the 7/8 searchable threshold, but the test fixtures exercise 7 models (provider.seven) and 9 models (provider.large) — the exact boundary value of 8 enabled models is never tested.
findings.evidence: Criterion 1.1: 'Add focused tests for the 7/8 threshold'. In the test file, provider.seven uses `Array.from({ length: 7 }, ...)` and provider.large lists 9 entries (large-model-1..7 plus raw-special/v2 and raw-special-v3). The component branches on `options.length < SEARCHABLE_MODEL_THRESHOLD` (8), so the `length === 8` path — the off-by-one boundary the criterion names — is unverified.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an 8-model provider fixture (or parameterize) asserting the searchable combobox path activates at exactly 8 options.

findings.claim: The dirty-draft guard only registers a window 'beforeunload' listener, which does not fire for client-side SPA navigation, so dirty provider drafts are still silently lost when the operator navigates within the app despite the test name claiming it 'protects dirty provider drafts'.
findings.evidence: The new effect does `window.addEventListener("beforeunload", preventUnsavedUnload)` gated on `hasDirty`, and the test only dispatches a synthetic `beforeunload` event. No router/navigation-blocker integration is present in the diff, so in-app route changes discard the draft cache without warning. The packet's own position.json confirms dirty-state hardening is a separate still-PENDING change (provider-settings-accessibility-dirty-state, 0/7), meaning this partial protection ships ahead of its real implementation.
findings.suggested_fix: Either defer the unload guard to the pending dirty-state change, or pair it with a router navigation blocker so SPA transitions are covered too.

findings.claim: Model search normalization uses locale-dependent `toLocaleLowerCase()`, which can break case-insensitive matching for users in locales with special casing rules (e.g., Turkish 'I' → 'ı').
findings.evidence: `function normalizeModelSearch(value: string) { return value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase(); }` is applied to both the query and option label/value in the Combobox `filter`. The acceptance criterion specifies 'literal, case-insensitive search terms', which `toLowerCase()` implements deterministically regardless of the user's locale.
findings.suggested_fix: Use `value.trim().toLowerCase()` (optionally with `localeCompare`/collator only if locale-aware matching is explicitly desired).
